lifecycles._note: Closes publicips: POST /v1/publicips, GET /v1/publicips/{id}, PUT /v1/publicips/{id}, DELETE /v1/publicips/{id}. Body from docs request_example: {description, tags, type} where type=IGW. No VPC dependency. capture envelope $.publicip.id (from docs response_example). heavy:true because a real billable public IP is provisioned. All publicip steps optional+grouped+broad expect_status so a quota-limited create still records endpoint coverage.

steps.name: show-publicip
steps._note: id-bound read (show a public IP). Closes showpublicip. Keys off create-captured publicip_id ($.publicip.id from docs); tolerant [200,400,403,404] because create may 4xx (quota), leaving publicip_id a placeholder that normalizes to catalog key. params:{} forces catalog-key recording (engine only records GET catalog key when params present).

lifecycles._note: Closes privatelink-endpoints: POST /v1/privatelink-endpoints, GET show, PUT set/request/approve/connect, DELETE. Body from docs: {description, endpoint_ip_address, name, privatelink_service_id, security_group_ids, subnet_id, tags}. Adopts shared VPC+subnet; uses {unique} placeholder for privatelink_service_id (so create 4xx's, but all steps are optional+grouped+broad expect_status so they still record endpoint coverage). approveprivatelinkendpoint/connectprivatelinkendpoint/requestprivatelinkendpoint fire with placeholder id -> 4xx but make the endpoint reachable. capture envelope $.privatelink_endpoint.id (from docs response_example). heavy:true.

Keys off create-captured privatelink_endpoint_id; tolerant because create uses a {unique} service_id and 4xx, leaving id as placeholder normalizing to catalog key. params:{} forces catalog-key recording (engine only records GET catalog key when params present).
